text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho throws a tantrum at training and says that she doesn't want to run, but I get the impression she's actually putting on a performance to test me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she really wasn't interested in running today, she wouldn't have shown up to training at all. Knowing there must be a reason she's here, I sit quietly and wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some time, Sweep Tosho speaks her mind. "Just believe in me. Listen to what I think. Don't try and force me to do what you think's right!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering me trustworthy, she opens up about where she wants to race next. And so, with the Oka Sho as our next destination, her search for racing magic begins anew.
